content:
lina_cs: Heads-up — noticed a cohort of accounts created during last quarter that never hit the 'first-touchpoint' flag. Likely impact: renewal pulse/health scoring is showing them as "engaged" when they’re actually uncontacted. Can we run a quick audit and reassign touchpoint ownership?

matt_ops: Oof, that explains a bunch of chatter I saw in the renewal queue. Do you have an example account id?

lina_cs: Yep — acct_2023_9817 is one. Many of these were created via the trial-api ingest flow around 2023-11-15. They have no outbound touches and no manual owner.

sarah_data: I'll pull a list. Running a lightweight query now to find accounts with created_at between 2023-11-10 and 2023-11-20 where first_touchpoint IS NULL and owner_id IS NULL.

sarah_data: SQL I ran:

```sql
SELECT account_id, created_at, source, last_activity
FROM accounts
WHERE created_at >= '2023-11-10'
  AND created_at <= '2023-11-20'
  AND first_touchpoint IS NULL
  AND owner_id IS NULL;
```

sarah_data: Got 128 rows. ~45% are from the webhook trial flow, rest are manual signups with missing integrator tags. Exporting to S3: s3://redwood-cs/ops/orphan-accounts/202311-sweep.csv

kevin_se: Thanks — fyi the trial-api recently changed payload shape (ticket 4721). That might have dropped the 'source' -> 'utm' mapping we rely on to auto-assign owners.

lina_cs: That mapping change would create a silent gap. Can we patch the mapping and backfill owners via a playbook run? We need to avoid bulk emailing until owners are assigned.

matt_ops: Proposal: 1) fix mapping in ingest (PR ready), 2) run a safe backfill that sets owner_id to oncall-csm if account signals 'enterprise' size, else assign to regional CS queue, 3) add a 'first-touchpoint-suspect' tag for records modified by backfill.

oliver_csm: +1 on suspect tag. For renewals pipeline I'd prefer a soft-caretail split so we don't surface them to the AMs until owner confirms. Also need to notify Sales Ops.

lina_cs: Can playbook-bot do a staged run? Steps: dedupe list, set owner_id (per rule), attach tag, create a follow-up task for assigned owner with template 'Intro + first-touch'. If owner is oncall-csm, route to #cs-oncall.

playbook-bot: Received job request: backfill-orphan-accounts-1948800000. I can run in --dry-run mode first. Use `/playbook run backfill-orphan-accounts --dry-run --preview 10` to preview.

kevin_se: PR for ingest mapping is at https://github.com/redwood/integrations/pull/518 — I'll merge once playbook dry-run looks good.

sarah_data: Dry-run preview (first 10 rows): acct_2023_9817 -> would be assigned to oncall-csm, acct_2023_9821 -> regional-eu, acct_2023_9834 -> oncall-csm. No conflicting owner fields.

lina_cs: Great — run full dry-run and drop CSV with proposed owner assignments into the same S3 folder (naming: s3://redwood-cs/ops/orphan-accounts/202311-proposed-assignments.csv).

matt_ops: After we confirm assignments, we should also update the health scoring logic to treat records with 'first-touchpoint-suspect' as 'unverified' so they don't inflate the healthy cohort metric. Ticketing that now: CS-6912.

oliver_csm: Can we also capture a sample prompt for CSMs to use on first contact? Quick template would speed outreach.

lina_cs: Draft template ready, will drop in the thread later. Thanks all — let's regroup after the dry-run. :thumbsup:
